观察电容器的充放电 · 3D 互动课件: Observing Capacitor Charging and Discharging · Interactive 3D Lesson
电容器里到底存了什么？能不能只用一个数把它的「肚量」量出来？: What exactly does a capacitor store? Can its "capacity" be measured with a single number?
开关一合，回路里立刻有电流，i 最大: The moment the switch closes, current flows in the circuit and i is at its maximum
u_C 升、i 变小：图10.4-1 接法下充电也经过 R，慢慢归零: u_C rises, i falls: in the Fig. 10.4-1 circuit charging also passes through R and slowly returns to zero
u_C = U、i = 0、q = C·U；断开电源电荷仍在: u_C = U, i = 0, q = C·U; the charge remains after the supply is disconnected
电流反向、经过 R：i 变负、u_C 慢慢落: The current reverses through R: i goes negative and u_C slowly falls
i-t 面积 = q，q-u 是一条过原点的直线，斜率 = C: Area under i-t = q; q-u is a straight line through the origin with slope = C

拖视角绕实验台看一圈，顺着导线走一遍回路: Drag the view around the bench and follow the wires around the circuit
Switch in the middle (open): i = 0.00 mA, u_C = 0.00 V; supply 8.0 V, R 3.3 kΩ, C 470 μF. Following the wires you can go all the way round "supply → switch 1 → top plate → bottom plate → back to supply"; the discharge loop goes through R and the current sensor in addition.
单刀双掷开关把电容器分别接到「电源」和「电阻」两个回路。教材图10.4-1 的电: The single-pole double-throw switch connects the capacitor either to the "supply" loop or to the "resistor" loop. In textbook Fig. 10.4-1 the ammeter is in the shared branch (both charging and discharging pass through it); in Fig. 10.4-2(a) the sensor is only in the discharge branch. This lesson draws both layouts and compares them in step 5.
U 8.0 V · R 3.3 kΩ · C 470 μF · 开关断开: U 8.0 V · R 3.3 kΩ · C 470 μF · switch open
单刀双掷开关有三个位置，不是两个：中间断开、倒向 1（充电）、倒向 2（放电）。: The single-pole double-throw switch has three positions, not two: open in the middle, to 1 (charge), to 2 (discharge).
教材两张图的接法不同：图10.4-1 的电阻与电流表在公共支路，图10.4-2: The textbook's two figures are wired differently: in Fig. 10.4-1 the resistor and ammeter are in the shared branch; in Fig. 10.4-2(a) the resistor and sensor are only in the discharge branch.
电流传感器与 R 串在同一条放电支路上，测的是同一个电流；中央零刻度毫安表以中位: The current sensor is in series with R in the same discharge branch and measures the same current; the center-zero milliammeter has its zero in the middle, so the needle can swing either way (a sensitive galvanometer works too without a sensor).
去掉这一步：学生不知道开关往哪边拨，也不知道两只表各自量的是哪一段。: Skip this step and students won't know which way to throw the switch, or which part each meter measures.
器材辨认是必做实验的第一项能力（课标 3.1.6「观察常见的电容器」）。: Recognizing the equipment is the first skill of a required experiment (curriculum 3.1.6 "observe common capacitors").
开关倒向 1，电流往哪走？指针往哪边打？: With the switch at 1, which way does current flow? Which way does the needle swing?
在 3D 里把开关拨杆合向 1（充电），等指针慢慢回到 0: In 3D, throw the switch lever to 1 (charge) and wait for the needle to slowly return to 0
这一段是图10.4-1 接法（R 在公共回路、中央零刻度毫安表在公共支路）。刚合: This part uses the Fig. 10.4-1 circuit (R in the shared loop, center-zero milliammeter in the shared branch). Just closed (t = 0⁺): i = +2.42 mA, needle near 2.4, u_C = 0.00 V; at t = 1τ = 1.55 s: u_C = 5.06 V, i = 0.89 mA; fully charged at 5τ = 7.75 s: u_C = 7.95 V, i = 0.02 mA, q = 3.73 mC; then open the switch and u_C is still 7.95 V.
充电电流流进上极板、极板电荷增加；u_C 越高剩下的电压差越小，电流越小；u_C: Charging current flows into the top plate and the plate charge increases; the higher u_C, the smaller the remaining voltage difference and the smaller the current; once u_C catches up with U the current is zero. Even with the supply disconnected, the charges on the two plates attract each other and stay stored in the capacitor (textbook p.38).
facts A2.5、A2.6、A2.11、A3.1、A4.2、B2.1 第 1: facts A2.5, A2.6, A2.11, A3.1, A4.2, B2.1 items 1, 15, charging table 1a
U 8.0 V · R 3.3 kΩ · C 470 μF · 图10.4-1: U 8.0 V · R 3.3 kΩ · C 470 μF · Fig. 10.4-1 circuit
充电电流的方向是「流进上极板」，台面上那支箭头必须指向上极板。: The charging current "flows into the top plate", so the arrow on the bench must point to the top plate.
图10.4-1 接法下充电也经过 R，所以指针是慢慢回零的（τ = R·C =: In the Fig. 10.4-1 circuit charging also passes through R, so the needle returns to zero slowly (τ = R·C = 1.55 s), but it never swings the other way.
充满的判据是 u_C 追上 U，不是「充够时间」；充满以后 i = 0。: The test for fully charged is u_C catching up with U, not "charged long enough"; once full, i = 0.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「电容要先充满电才让电流通过」，也会漏掉「断开电源电荷仍在: Skip this step and students think "a capacitor must be fully charged before letting current through", and miss the textbook's "the charge remains after the supply is disconnected".
必考：为什么充电电流越来越小；Q = C·U；断开电源后电荷仍在（教材 p.38: Must-know: why the charging current keeps decreasing; Q = C·U; charge remains after disconnecting the supply (textbook p.38).
把开关倒向 2，指针往哪边偏？板间电场反了吗？: With the switch at 2, which way does the needle swing? Does the field between the plates reverse?
把拨杆从 1 拨到 2（放电），看指针打到另一侧: Throw the lever from 1 to 2 (discharge) and watch the needle swing to the other side
还是图10.4-1 接法（同一只毫安表串在两段回路里）。刚拨过去：u_C = 8: Still the Fig. 10.4-1 circuit (the same milliammeter in both loops). Just switched: u_C = 8.00 V, i = −2.42 mA, and the needle swings to the other side; at t = 1τ = 1.55 s: u_C = 2.94 V, i = −0.89 mA (at the same time during charging it was +0.89 mA). The field arrow between the plates keeps its direction and only gets shorter.
放电电流与充电方向相反（同一只表指针反偏就是最直观的证据）。这一段两段共用同一个: The discharge current flows opposite to the charging current (the same meter's needle swinging the other way is the most direct evidence). Here both parts share τ = R·C, so the charging and discharging curves mirror each other about u_C = U/2; the field between the plates always points from top plate to bottom plate, unchanged during discharge, only weaker.
facts A2.12、A2.13、A3.1、B2.1 第 1、15 条；D2、: facts A2.12, A2.13, A3.1, B2.1 items 1, 15; D2, D3, D5, D6, discharge table 2
放电电流与充电电流方向相反；同一只中央零刻度表指针反偏，是最直观的证据。: The discharge current is opposite to the charging current; the same center-zero meter's needle swinging the other way is the most direct evidence.
两段都经过 R，所以共用同一个 τ = R·C：u_充 + u_放 = 8.00: Both parts pass through R, so they share τ = R·C: u_chg + u_dis = 8.00 V, |i_dis| − i_chg = 0.00 mA.
u_C 单调下降，但板间电场方向始终不变——不要把「电流反向」讲成「电场反向」。: u_C falls steadily, but the field between the plates never changes direction; don't describe "the current reverses" as "the field reverses".
去掉这一步：学生会把「电流反向」讲成「电场反向」，这是旧批次最容易教反的一条。: Skip this step and students describe "the current reverses" as "the field reverses", the point earlier classes most often got backward.
必考陷阱：放电时板间电场是否反向（facts A7.3）。: Must-know trap: does the field between the plates reverse during discharge? (facts A7.3)
不用万用表，怎么从一张 I-t 图读出电容器原来存了多少电荷？: Without a multimeter, how can an I-t graph tell us how much charge the capacitor held?
把拨杆拨到 2 放电（图10.4-2 甲 接法），盯住屏幕上被着色的面积和 q: Throw the lever to 2 to discharge (Fig. 10.4-2(a) circuit) and watch the shaded area on screen and the q reading
这一步换成图10.4-2 甲 的接法（R 与电流传感器只在放电支路），曲线才画得: This step switches to the Fig. 10.4-2(a) circuit (R and current sensor only in the discharge branch) so the curve can be drawn: τ is still 1.55 s, the discharge curve is below the axis, and the q reading falls from 3.76 mC (t = 0) to 1.38 mC (t = 1τ). Counting squares (the 0.4 s × 0.2 mA grid of textbook Fig. 10.4-3): the curve covers 45 squares of 0.08 mC each, giving 3.60 mC, 0.13 mC less than the exact area of 3.73 mC (3.6 % low); the tall narrow rectangle of textbook p.39 question (1) (0–0.2 s) has an area of 0.48 mC.
i = dq/dt，所以 i-t 曲线下的面积就是流过的电荷量：q = q₀ +: i = dq/dt, so the area under the i-t curve is the charge that has flowed: q = q₀ + S. Counting squares is a rough version of the same integral (textbook p.39 question (2) asks students to estimate with squares).
facts A2.4、A2.16、A3.2、B2.1 第 2、4、11、13 条: facts A2.4, A2.16, A3.2, B2.1 items 2, 4, 11, 13; square-counting table
面积的单位是「电流 × 时间」= 电荷，正好是 mC。: The unit of area is "current × time" = charge, conveniently in mC.
放电段曲线在轴下方，q 从 3.76 mC 往下掉：曲线剩下的那部分面积才是电容: In discharge the curve is below the axis and q falls from 3.76 mC: the area under the rest of the curve is the charge still left in the capacitor.
教材网格：小格 0.4 s × 0.2 mA = 0.08 mC，45 格 =: Textbook grid: each square 0.4 s × 0.2 mA = 0.08 mC, 45 squares = 3.60 mC, 3.6 % below the exact value.
去掉这一步：q 就只是一个「读出来的数」，学生没有「测出来」的办法。: Skip this step and q is just "a number read off", with no way for students to measure it.
必考：I-t 图像面积表示电荷量；数格子是最常见的考法（教材 p.39 问题 (: Must-know: the area under an I-t graph is the charge; counting squares is the most common exam format (textbook p.39 question (2)).
教材问：要测绘充电时的 I-t 图像，应该怎样连接电路？: The textbook asks: to plot the I-t graph during charging, how should the circuit be connected?
把接法拨回图10.4-1（充电也经过 R），再合向 1 充满：这次指针慢慢回零: Switch the circuit back to Fig. 10.4-1 (charging also passes through R), then throw to 1 and charge fully: this time the needle returns to zero slowly
两种接法对着看：图10.4-2 甲（刚才那一段）充电只经过 r = 0.2 kΩ: Comparing the two circuits: in Fig. 10.4-2(a) (the previous part) charging passes only through r = 0.2 kΩ, τ_chg = 0.09 s, full in 0.47 s, with no current reading in that part; in Fig. 10.4-1 charging also passes through R, τ = 1.55 s, the needle returns to zero slowly, and only then can the charging curve be measured. With the same τ the two parts mirror each other: u_chg + u_dis = 8.00 V, |i_dis| − i_chg = 0.00 mA.
To measure the charging current, R must also be in the charging loop and the meter in the shared branch; this is the answer to the question at the end of textbook p.39. The time scales of the two circuits differ by a factor of 16 (τ_chg / τ_dis = r / R = 0.0606).
facts A3.2（教材末问题）、A4.2、B2.1 第 0、15 条；D5、: facts A3.2 (textbook's final question), A4.2, B2.1 items 0, 15; D5, D6, D8; charging table 1b
The end of textbook p.39 asks this, and the answer is: move R and the sensor into the shared branch (the Fig. 10.4-1 layout).
挪过去以后充电变慢（τ 从 0.09 s 变 1.55 s），充电曲线才画得出来: Once moved, charging slows (τ from 0.09 s to 1.55 s), and only then can the charging curve be drawn.
两段共用同一个 τ 时，u_充 + u_放 = 8.00 V、|i_放| − i: When both parts share the same τ, u_chg + u_dis = 8.00 V and |i_dis| − i_chg = 0.00 mA.
去掉这一步：学生只会测放电，「充电时的电流长什么样」永远是个谜。: Skip this step and students can only measure discharge; "what the charging current looks like" stays a mystery.
教材原问，属于必做实验的电路设计考点。: An original textbook question, part of the circuit design skills for this required experiment.
把电荷量和对应的电压一对一对记下来画图，会看到什么？: If we record charge and the matching voltage in pairs and plot them, what do we see?
放电过程中点屏幕上左侧的「记录一组」，记满 5 行: During discharge click "record a set" on the left of the screen until 5 rows are recorded
默认 470 μF（q/mC = 0.47 × u/V，两个量一眼分得开）：5: Default 470 μF (q/mC = 0.47 × u/V, so the two quantities are easy to tell apart): 5 rows (8.00 V, 3.76 mC), (2.94, 1.38), (1.08, 0.51), (0.40, 0.19), (0.15, 0.07); the 5 points lie on a straight line through the origin; fitted slope through the origin 0.4700 mC/V → C = 470 μF.
q ∝ u_C，比值 q/u_C 是一个只由电容器本身决定的量——这就是电容的定: q ∝ u_C, and the ratio q/u_C is a quantity set only by the capacitor itself; this is the definition of capacitance C = q/u_C. Textbook p.40 reaches the same conclusion with "two identical capacitors in parallel → charge and voltage both halve"; this lesson makes it quantitative.
facts A2.1、A2.2、A2.16、A2.19、B2.1 第 9 条、作: facts A2.1, A2.2, A2.16, A2.19, B2.1 item 9, graphing table
C = q / u_C （q-u 图的斜率）: C = q / u_C (slope of the q-u graph)
C 470 μF · U 8.0 V · 记 5 行 · 过原点拟合: C 470 μF · U 8.0 V · record 5 rows · fit through origin
记 4–6 组就够画直线，不用记满全过程；每记一行，屏幕上的点就多一个。: 4–6 sets are enough to draw the line; no need to record the whole process. Each row recorded adds a point on screen.
q 是面积测出来的（剩余电荷 = 这一时刻之后曲线下的面积），不是拿铭牌 C 乘: q is measured from the area (remaining charge = area under the curve after this moment), not calculated by multiplying the rated C by u_C.
q/mC = 0.47 × u/V，两个量的数字不重样，学生不会把两个量当成一个: q/mC = 0.47 × u/V, so the two numbers never match and students won't confuse the two quantities.
去掉这一步：C = Q/U 就成了背下来的公式，学生不知道它是怎么来的。: Skip this step and C = Q/U becomes a memorized formula, with students not knowing where it comes from.
必考：由 q-U 图求电容（斜率）；教材 p.40 的并联分半是同一结论的另一条: Must-know: finding capacitance from a q-U graph (slope); the parallel-halving on textbook p.40 is another road to the same conclusion.
换一只小电容，斜率和面积会怎么变？只换电阻呢？: With a smaller capacitor, how do the slope and area change? What if only the resistor changes?
把电容换到 220 μF，再拨到 2 放电：看面积和斜率跟着谁变: Switch the capacitor to 220 μF, then throw to 2 to discharge: see what the area and slope follow
换 C（470 → 220 μF）：放电总面积从 3.73 变 1.75 mC（: Changing C (470 → 220 μF): the total discharge area goes from 3.73 to 1.75 mC (proportionally smaller), and the q-u slope from 0.4700 to 0.2200 mC/V → measured C = 220 μF; then changing R (3.3 → 4.7 kΩ, with the capacitor back to the same 470 μF): τ goes from 1.55 to 2.21 s and i(0) from −2.42 to −1.70 mA, a lower, wider curve, but the area is still 3.73 mC and the slope still 0.4700 mC/V → C is still 470 μF.
面积 = C·U、斜率 = C：电容变了两者都变，电阻变了两者都不变。q/u_C: Area = C·U and slope = C: change the capacitor and both change, change the resistor and neither does. q/u_C is set by the capacitor itself, regardless of how it discharges.
facts A2.1、A2.2、B2.1 第 5、9 条、面积与 R 无关表: facts A2.1, A2.2, B2.1 items 5, 9, table on area independent of R
C changes → area and slope both change (3.73 → 1.75 mC, 0.4700 → 0.2200).
R 变 → 面积与斜率都不变，只是曲线矮而宽（τ 从 1.55 s 变 2.21: R changes → neither area nor slope changes; the curve is just lower and wider (τ from 1.55 s to 2.21 s).
「充得多快」和「最后搬走多少电荷」是两件事。: "How fast it charges" and "how much charge is finally moved" are two different things.
去掉这一步：学生会用「放电快不快」判断「电容大不大」，那个错就消不掉。: Skip this step and students judge "how big the capacitance is" by "how fast it discharges", a mistake that never goes away.
必考：电容的定义式与「比值不变」（facts A2.2）；易错「R 越大电荷越少: Must-know: the defining equation of capacitance and "the ratio is constant" (facts A2.2); common mistake: "a larger R means less charge".
铭牌写着 470 μF，为什么测出来不是 470？: The label says 470 μF. Why isn't the measured value 470?
打开「真实器材」，看测出来的电容变成多少: Turn on "real equipment" and see what capacitance is measured
打开后元件变成实际值：C′ = 454.19 μF、R′ = 3.3598 kΩ: With it on, the components take real values: C′ = 454.19 μF, R′ = 3.3598 kΩ → τ = 1.53 s; fully charged q (from area) = 3.62 mC, u_C = 7.94 V → measured C = 456 μF, while the label still says 470 μF. Then an over-range demo: set U to 12.0 V (milliammeter ±3 mA) → i(0) = 3.64 mA pins the meter, the measured area is 5.51 mC and "area ÷ (C·U)" = 0.9770, 1.6 % lower relative to 0.9933 without overrange.
① 456 μF ≠ 470 μF is the component tolerance (true value 454.19 μF, −3.4 %), not a measurement mistake: the label is a nominal value and electrolytic capacitors allow ±10 %, so capacitance must be measured. ② Errors in the measurement itself are separate: the milliammeter's 0.1 mA quantization and sampling (< 1 % by default), clipping when the current pins the meter, which always makes the area too small (1.6 % relative), and counting squares, 3.6 % low.
facts B2.1 第 10、12 条、B3 第 3 条、B1.2、真实模式表: facts B2.1 items 10, 12, B3 item 3, B1.2, real-equipment table
铭牌 470 μF · 真值 454.19 μF · 实测 456 μF: Label 470 μF · true 454.19 μF · measured 456 μF
铭牌是标称值，测出来的是实际值，差 3 % 属于容差——所以电容要测。: The label is a nominal value and the measurement gives the actual value; a 3 % difference is tolerance, which is why capacitance is measured.
测量本身的误差有方向：量化让读数抖，超量程让面积一定偏小，数格子法也偏小。: Measurement errors have directions: quantization makes readings jitter, overrange always makes the area too small, and counting squares is also low.
同一个种子、同一组控件读数可重复（这是软件性质，不是误差分类的依据）。: With the same seed and the same control readings, results repeat (a property of the software, not a basis for classifying errors).
去掉这一步：学生会把「测出来和标称不一样」当成自己算错。: Skip this step and students treat "measured differs from nominal" as their own calculation mistake.
实验素养：说出真实器材的误差来源与方向（课标「科学探究」）。: Experimental literacy: state the sources and directions of error with real equipment (curriculum "scientific inquiry").
考核：自己选 U、R、C，让这一段测得出的电容够大、峰值又不顶表: Check: choose your own U, R and C so that this part measures a large enough capacitance without the peak pinning the meter
把 C 换大（并让 R 别太小），让这三个判据同时成立，保持 10 s: Use a larger C (and don't make R too small) so all three criteria hold at once, and hold for 10 s
考核在**放电段**（图10.4-2 甲，传感器在读数）上做，三个判据都由这一段: The check is done on the **discharge part** (Fig. 10.4-2(a), sensor reading), and all three criteria are computed from its readings: ① discharge peak |i(0)| ≤ 6.67 mA (a third of the sensor's 20 mA range); ② capacitance measured from the small readouts C = q/u_C ≥ 900 μF; ③ supply voltage inferred from the initial discharge current |i(0)| × R ≥ 2.0 V (proving it was fully charged before switching to 2). One solution: U = 8.0 V, R = 2.2 kΩ, C = 1000 μF → |i(0)| = 3.64 mA, inferred U = 8.0 V, measured C = 1000 μF; another: U = 12.0 V, R = 3.3 kΩ, C = 1000 μF.
没有新结论，只是把前八步的关系连起来用一遍：峰值 |i(0)| = U/R 决定: No new conclusion, just using the relations of the first eight steps together: the peak |i(0)| = U/R decides "whether it pins the meter", q/u_C gives the capacitance, and only a full charge makes the initial discharge current equal U/R; all three come from readings on the same discharge curve.
facts A2.1, A2.2, B1.2, B2.1 items 1, 9, 15, B2.1 item 17 (check criteria and standard values)
8.0 V / 2.2 kΩ / 1000 μF 是一组解: 8.0 V / 2.2 kΩ / 1000 μF is one solution
前提：拨到 2 之前先把开关合向 1 充满——否则放电初始电流很小，反推出来的: Prerequisite: throw to 1 and charge fully before switching to 2; otherwise the initial discharge current is small, the inferred U is small, and criterion ③ fails.
峰值 |i(0)| = U/R 不能超过传感器量程的三分之一：R 换小到 1.0: The peak |i(0)| = U/R must not exceed a third of the sensor's range: R below 1.0 kΩ, or U at 12 V with a small R, will pin the meter.
要过第 ② 条就把电容换大（470 → 1000 μF）：测得 C 就是 q/u: To pass criterion ② use a larger capacitor (470 → 1000 μF): the measured C is q/u_C, the capacitor's own ratio just like its label.
没有新结论：三个判据分别对应前八步的「量程」「电容定义」「充满」三条，一次用全。: No new conclusion: the three criteria match the "range", "definition of capacitance" and "full charge" points of the first eight steps, all used at once.
综合：|i(0)| = U/R（量程约束）+ C = q/u_C（定义式）+ 充: Combined: |i(0)| = U/R (range constraint) + C = q/u_C (definition) + only a full charge gives the peak (order of operations).

教材图10.4-1 中，电流表串在公共支路上。把开关 S 由 1 拨到 2 时，: In textbook Fig. 10.4-1 the ammeter is in the shared branch. When switch S is moved from 1 to 2, the ammeter needle will
向同一侧偏得更小: Swing less to the same side
先向相反一侧偏、再回到原侧: Swing to the opposite side first, then back
充电电流流进上极板，放电电流由正极板经 R 流回负极板，方向相反；同一只中央零刻: Charging current flows into the top plate, while discharge current flows from the positive plate through R back to the negative plate, the opposite direction; the same center-zero meter carries both, so the needle swings to the opposite side (facts A2.12, B2.1 item 15).
图10.4-1 接法下用直流 8 V 电源给 470 μF 电容器充电，充电电流: Charging a 470 μF capacitor from an 8 V DC supply in the Fig. 10.4-1 circuit, the charging current
越来越小，最后为零: Keeps decreasing and finally reaches zero
越来越小，最后不为零: Keeps decreasing but never reaches zero
u_C 升高使 (U − u_C) 变小，i = (U − u_C)/R 随之减: As u_C rises, (U − u_C) shrinks, so i = (U − u_C)/R decreases; when u_C catches up with U the current is zero (facts A2.6, charging table 1a).
电容器放电的过程中，两极板间的电场: While a capacitor discharges, the electric field between its plates
方向不变，只变弱: Keeps its direction and only weakens
方向不变，越来越强: Keeps its direction and keeps strengthening
放电只是极板电荷量减小，正负极板没有互换，所以场强方向恒由上极板指向下极板，只是: Discharging only reduces the plate charge; the positive and negative plates do not swap, so the field always points from top plate to bottom plate and only weakens (facts A2.13, assertion D3: Ê·ĥ = +1).

每小格 0.4 s × 0.2 mA = 0.08 mC，45 格 × 0.08: Each square is 0.4 s × 0.2 mA = 0.08 mC, so 45 × 0.08 = 3.60 mC, −0.13 mC from the exact area of 3.73 mC (facts B2.1 item 11).
把放电过程中测得的多组 (u_C, q) 画成 q-u 图像，得到的是一条过原点: Plotting the (u_C, q) pairs measured during discharge as a q-u graph gives a straight line through the origin with slope 0.47 mC/V. The capacitance of this capacitor is
C = q/u_C = slope × 1000 = 470 μF (facts B2.1 item 9; q/mC = 0.47 × u/V).
某同学把电源调到 12 V 后，毫安表指针顶表，用面积法测出的电荷量: A student sets the supply to 12 V and the milliammeter needle pins. The charge measured by the area method is
忽大忽小无从判断: Sometimes high, sometimes low, impossible to tell
电流超过量程时曲线顶部被削平，曲线下面积变小，所以测出的电荷量一定偏小（fact: When the current exceeds the range the top of the curve is clipped and the area under it shrinks, so the measured charge is always too small (facts B2.1 item 12: area ÷ (C·U) is 0.9770 < 0.9933).
